title: Cosmic Monk Awakening
description: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a glowing bald monk in a multicolored patchwork robe standing behind a stone altar. The background displays a large circular cosmic mandala with a sun, spiral galaxy center, vibrant nebula swirls, floating crystals, and a dark mountain range over reflective water with ethereal hands emerging from below.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting of a glowing bald monk with wide eyes wearing a multicolored patchwork robe standing behind a stone altar.
